info.title: Signal Sentinel Scanner
info.description: CLI security scanner for MCP server configurations AND Agent Skill packages. Detects prompt injection, tool poisoning, credential exposure, data exfiltration, supply chain vulnerabilities, rug-pull schema mutations, shadow tool injection, and skill integrity issues. 25 security rules aligned with OWASP Agentic AI Top 10 + OWASP MCP Top 10. Supports stdio, HTTP/SSE, WebSocket transports, SKILL.md scanning, SARIF output, Sigma rule import, and verified offline operation.
